Camila, hi, it's Sofia from Italy. I have a call with the global team on Friday, and they asked me to present the structure in South America. I have the organisation chart, but honestly I don't understand it. Here in Italy everything is one entity, so when you say the bank, the finance company and the rental company, I don't know what each one really does, or who the clients are. Could you send me three lines, one for each company? What it does and who its clients are. Nothing long, please, three lines. If you can send it before Thursday evening, I can prepare my part on Friday morning. Thank you so much. Talk soon.

Welcome to the group. In two minutes, here is the business you have just joined. We sell cars, and around those cars we run three companies. The bank holds the licence and provides services to the whole structure. The finance company works with the dealer and with the driver: it gives the dealer a floor plan, which pays for the cars in the showroom, and it gives the customer retail financing when the car is sold. The rental company works with corporate clients who want to use cars, not to own them. One number tells you how well the system works: the penetration rate. Today it is close to forty per cent, which means four out of ten cars sold are financed by us. The other six are financed by somebody else.
